fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential registry activity of GoToMyPC RMM tool
fields.name: Potential GoToMyPC RMM Tool Registry Activity
fields.query: event.category="registry" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (registry.keyPath contains "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\WOW6432Node\\Citrix\\GoToMyPc" or registry.keyPath contains "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\WOW6432Node\\Citrix\\GoToMyPc\\GuestInvite" or registry.keyPath contains "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\\SOFTWARE\\Citrix\\GoToMyPc\\FileTransfer\\history" or registry.keyPath contains "HKEY_USERS\\<SID>\\SOFTWARE\\Citrix\\GoToMyPc\\FileTransfer\\history"))
